articles.title: This Robot Hand Walks on Its Fingers Like a Creepy Thing
articles.summary: Engineers in Switzerland built a robot hand that can balance on its fingers, type on a keyboard and even play a simple video game. It is inspired by the spooky hand called Thing.

articles.title: Role Model Jokes About Being Maine's Most Famous Person
articles.summary: Singer Role Model appeared on Chicken Shop Date and joked about whether he is Maine's most famous celebrity, mentioning Stephen King and Anna Kendrick. His new album reached the top 10.

articles.title: Doobie Brothers Singer Reconnects With Son He Placed for Adoption
articles.summary: Michael McDonald of the Doobie Brothers reconnected with Michael Goessling, the son he placed for adoption as a teenager. Goessling is 59 and learned his father's identity last year.
